features.title: All your money, in one place
features.subtitle: From the control center to loan amortization, every module shares the same calculation engine and the same auditable record.

items.title: Control center
items.description: A dashboard with your balance, liquidity, net worth and critical alerts in real time.

items.title: Accounts
items.description: Organize banks, cash and pockets. Every movement stays linked to its account.

items.title: Transactions & categories
items.description: Record income and expenses with clear categories and browse your full history.

items.title: Atomic transfers
items.description: Double-entry movements that either complete entirely or never apply at all.

items.title: Credit cards
items.description: Check available credit, debt and payments without losing sight of interest.

items.title: Savings goals

items.title: Investments
items.description: Track your portfolio and its returns with exact values, not approximations.

items.title: Loans
items.description: Manage installments and amortization with principal and interest kept separate.

items.title: Variable expenses

items.title: Fixed expenses

benefits.title: Financial engineering that never leaves numbers to chance
benefits.subtitle: Every design decision is meant to keep your information exact, traceable and hard to corrupt.

items.title: Accuracy without rounding errors
items.description: Amounts are stored as integer cents and computed with Decimal.js and banker's rounding (half-even). No floats.

items.title: History is the source of truth
items.description: Balances are reconciled from transaction history. If something does not add up, traceability reveals it.

items.title: Traceable multi-currency
items.description: Every operation keeps its original amount and the applied exchange rate, using ISO 4217 codes.

items.title: No duplicate charges
items.description: Operations use idempotency keys: retrying never creates a repeated movement.

items.title: Soft deletes and audit trail
items.description: Financial records are never destroyed: they are deactivated and keep who, when and where they were changed.

items.title: Validation and security
items.description: Server-side validation with Zod, Argon2id password hashing, httpOnly cookies and attempt limits.

steps.title: Start tracking in three steps
steps.subtitle: No complex setup: create your account and start organizing your finances the same day.

items.title: Create your account
items.description: Sign up in minutes and access your private workspace. No card required.

items.title: Add your accounts
items.description: Set up your banks, cash and pockets with their corresponding currency.

items.title: Record and grow
items.description: Log movements, set goals and watch your net worth grow with exact data.

security.title: Built with a Zero Trust mindset
security.description: Security is not added at the end: it is designed from the first line. Every input is validated and authorized on the server, and every sensitive operation leaves a trail.

controls.title: Argon2id password hashing
controls.description: Credentials are never stored in plain text or compared insecurely.

controls.title: httpOnly session cookies
controls.description: The session travels in cookies that are not accessible from browser JavaScript.

controls.title: Server-side validation
controls.description: Every input is revalidated and authorized on the server, not only in the browser.

controls.title: Attempt limits
controls.description: Sensitive access points are protected against brute force and abuse.

security.note: FinanceTrackerPro does not hold your money: it is the tool where you record and understand your finances. Multi-factor authentication is considered as a future evolution of the sign-in system.

faq.title: Answers to the most common questions
faq.subtitle: If you still have a question, create your account and try it with no commitment.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: You can create your account and start tracking your finances at no cost. The product is meant to be used from the very first minute.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Passwords are protected with Argon2id, the session uses httpOnly cookies and all validation is repeated on the server. Financial records are kept with soft deletes and an audit trail.

items.question: Does it support multiple currencies?
items.answer: Yes. We work with ISO 4217 codes and keep each operation's original amount and exchange rate so you can audit any conversion.

items.question: Can I use it on my phone?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is responsive and designed to work comfortably on a phone, with touch targets and adapted navigation.

items.question: Can I track fixed and variable expenses?
items.answer: Yes. The system separates recurring expenses from variable ones and groups them by category so you can see exactly where your money goes.

items.question: What if I make a mistake when recording something?
items.answer: Movements are corrected without destroying history: deletes are logical and every change keeps its audit trail.
